text.description_html:
Michael Healy MH3193, Ring Front Door Knocker in Oiled Bronze

The Oiled Bronze Ring Door Knocker has a traditional look that makes it a wonderful addition to any historic home. This sandcast brass ring front door knocker has an oiled bronze finish and comes packaged with all the necessary mounting hardware. It is thru-bolt mounted, which means the mounting screws go all the way through the door and are visible from the interior.

Each door knocker is beautifully packed and is signed and dated by the artist, Michael Healy.

Features and Specifications of the Traditional Ring Knocker:

  • Material: Sandcast Brass
  • Finish: Oiled Bronze
  • Height: 4"
  • Width: 4"
  • Mounting Hole Centers: 3-1/4"
  • Projection Off Door: 1-1/2"
  • Mounting: Thru-Bolt Mounting
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Available in 2 finishes:
Oiled Bronze Polished Brass

Sold Individually
